_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED BY THE 9/1 PRE-CLOSE. NOTHING WAS REMOVED, AND THAT IS A CHECKED RESULT RATHER THAN A SKIPPED STEP: this file holds exactly one row, AVGO, and its event is still AHEAD by one session. The check was made against a LIVE forward earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-07 rather than inherited from the note the 8/31 pre-close left, and it returns AVGO fiscal Q3 2026, report date 2026-09-02, timing pm, verified true, estimate 3.16, no actual yet. No row carries a date in the past, so nothing is stale and nothing is deleted. SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE AND THIS IS THE LARGEST SINGLE-SLOT CORRECTION THIS FILE HAS CARRIED: AVGO 369.75 bid / 369.80 ask at 2026-09-01T19:36:46.263349996Z, last 369.785, against a 370.34 settled close, so -0.16% on the session. That replaces the 363.04 the 9/1 open wrote seven hours earlier - a move of 6.71 or 1.85% WITHIN A SINGLE SESSION, and the row would have gone into tomorrow's print carrying a reference price nearly two percent wrong had this step been treated as a formality. It is the AMD-at-522.95-on-a-486-morning failure in miniature, caught the same day rather than the next, and it is the reason the refresh is unconditional rather than done once the number looks stale enough to matter. THE 9/1 AND 9/2 CLUSTERS BEHIND IT ARE RE-CONFIRMED ON THE SAME PULL: PANW, DELL, CRDO, MDB and GTLB tonight, then AI, SNOW, NTAP, FIVE, PVH, HPE, OLLI and AVGO on 9/2, with ZS, DOCU, GWRE, PATH, IOT, ASAN, AMBA, LULU and CIEN on 9/3 pm. impliedMove STAYS NULL AND THE REASON IS THE SAME ONE AS YESTERDAY, RE-CHECKED RATHER THAN COPIED: no straddle was pulled because item 3 is owed before an earnings HOLD, and THE BOARD IS FLAT INTO THE BELL. Both position lists are empty on live pulls and both order lists are empty on a 2026-08-26 floor, so nothing is carried into tonight's cluster or tomorrow's AVGO print, and no hold crosses it. Branch one was checked against the day's only specification and did not bind it - the 09:47 DG entry is a discount retailer with no read-through from a semiconductor print, and it expired unexecuted at 15:30 in any case. The straddle becomes owed the moment a position exists that would carry into 9/2, and the first run that can create one is the 9/2 open, which fires on the morning of the print itself. THE ROW'S OWN PRUNING BELONGS TO THE 9/3 OPEN, the first run after the event.

moves.source: SPOT REFRESHED BY THE 2026-09-01 PRE-CLOSE, WHICH IS THE PRUNING SLOT: 369.75 bid / 369.80 ask at 2026-09-01T19:36:46.263349996Z, last 369.785, against a 370.34 settled close, so -0.16% on the session. That replaces the 363.04 the 9/1 open wrote at 13:42:53Z - a swing of 6.71 or 1.85% inside a single session, and the largest single-slot spot correction this file has carried. AVGO fell 1.97% into the open's read and has taken essentially all of it back by the bell, which is precisely why a reference price is refreshed on every pruning pass rather than when it looks wrong: the open's number was accurate when it was written and would have been 1.85% wrong going into the print. THE EVENT IS UNCHANGED AND RE-VERIFIED on a live forward earnings pull covering 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-07: AVGO fiscal Q3 2026, report date 2026-09-02, timing pm, verified true, estimate 3.16, no actual. The row is NOT removed and its branches are NOT touched - the event is still one session ahead, and the 9/3 open owns pruning this row once the print has happened. THE BOARD IS FLAT INTO THE BELL AND THEREFORE NOTHING CROSSES THIS PRINT: equity positions empty, option positions with nonzero=true empty, both order lists empty on a 2026-08-26 created_at floor, 1011.15 all settled. The day's only specification, the 09:47 DG buy at a 128.40 limit, was checked against branch one at the open and did not bind - a discount retailer carries no read-through from a semiconductor print - and it expired unexecuted at 15:30 with the tape 2.24% above its limit, so the question is moot twice over. impliedMove STAYS NULL BECAUSE NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED, and that is correct rather than an omission: item 3 is owed before an earnings HOLD, no position exists to hold, and a number this board did not pull does not exist. It becomes owed the moment a position exists that would carry into 9/2 - which now means only the 9/2 open itself, firing on the morning of the print, and branch one already tells that run what it must do before it may propose one.

branches.cond: An entry considered in AVGO itself, or in a semiconductor or enterprise-software sympathy name, whose five-session time stop would carry it through 2026-09-02
branches.act: Refused unless the position is sized and stopped to survive the gap, or is closed before the print by a pre-close run that says so explicitly
branches.why: This is the same arithmetic that refused AVGO this morning and SMCI on 8/12, applied forward to the date rather than rediscovered on 9/1. A -8% equity stop does not survive an event gap: the realistic bad case gaps THROUGH the exit rather than filling at it, so the stop is decorative and the real risk is the implied move, unpriced. The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright. What makes this a branch rather than a blanket ban is the escape clause named in it - a position may still be opened if it is deliberately closed before the print, and the run that opens it must write that intention down at entry rather than discover the conflict on 9/1.

branches.cond: An entry is opened on or after 2026-08-28 whose time stop lands on or after 9/2, and the run wants to hold it through the print
branches.act: The ATM straddle is pulled and quoted first, or there is no hold
branches.why: Item 3 of the checklist, stated as a dated duty so that no run has to infer it. This board has a standing rule that a number which was not pulled does not exist, and item 3 is the place that rule is most often quietly skipped - because the straddle is only owed before a HOLD, it is tempting to treat the hold as already decided and the number as a formality. It is the other way round: the number decides the hold. SMCI was refused on exactly this reading when a 14.2% implied move was found to swallow an 8% stop.

branches.cond: AVGO gaps hard on 9/2 and the 9/3 open wants to trade the reaction
branches.act: Not on the reaction bar - the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is the entry, and item 2 governs
branches.why: Written now, six sessions early and with nothing at stake, for the same reason branch one of the MRVL row was widened on 8/21 before it cost anything: a pre-commitment made on the morning it binds is not a pre-commitment. The reaction day is not the entry this rulebook buys, and a +8% gap is a wait signal rather than a buy signal. NVDA on 8/27 is the worked example this board already has - it was refused at +7.33% on the reaction bar, a tenth of a point off the line, with the gap landing into the top of its own prior congestion.
